findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_place, get_place_reviews, get_place_photos, get_place_posts, get_linkedin_profile, get_linkedin_company, get_linkedin_employee_stats, get_linkedin_posts, get_linkedin_post, get_linkedin_post_comments, get_linkedin_post_reactions, get_linkedin_activity, search_linkedin_jobs, get_linkedin_job, get_linkedin_ad, get_linkedin_group, search_linkedin_groups, get_instagram_profile, get_instagram_posts, get_instagram_post, get_instagram_comments, get_instagram_hashtag, get_tiktok_profile, get_tiktok_followers, get_tiktok_videos, get_tiktok_video, get_tiktok_comments, get_tiktok_trending, get_x_profile, get_x_posts, get_x_post, get_x_replies, get_x_retweeters, get_x_followers, get_x_community, sign_up · Private data: get_linkedin_company_people, get_linkedin_posts, get_instagram_profile, sign_up · Public sink: get_linkedin_profile, get_linkedin_posts, get_linkedin_post, get_linkedin_post_comments, get_linkedin_post_reactions, get_linkedin_activity, get_instagram_post, get_instagram_comments, get_instagram_hashtag, get_x_posts, get_x_post, get_x_replies, get_x_retweeters, sign_up · Destructive: search_linkedin_ads.
